$comment: Copy this file, fill it in, and pass it to Invoke-EDiscoveryExport.ps1 -ConfigFile. Values below mirror the proven 'outage request' pull.

case.name: 6344 - GPA-2526 Claim - Outage Request Search
case.description: Keyword pull: outage request, Mar-Oct 2022, GSI + Environet mailboxes.

search.name: Outage Request Search
search.$comment: Each keyword element becomes an OR'd KQL group, e.g. ['outage request'] -> (outage request). Set contentQuery to raw KQL to override keywords+dates entirely.

export.$comment: singlePst:false adds 'splitSource' for one PST per mailbox. format: pst or msg.

auth.$comment: mode: app-only | interactive. certThumbprint resolves from CurrentUser/LocalMachine store; or set certPath to a .pfx (+ certPasswordEnv naming an env var holding its password). downloadResourceAppId is the first-party Purview eDiscovery download resource; leave as-is.
